When you take a Big Five test, you will receive scores for five dimensions of personality:. This makes the Big Five model distinct from many pop psychology systems that classify people in terms of personality "types." results.content: # The 10 Scorpio Personality Traits to Know. ## What Is a Scorpio? ## Scorpio Personality Traits. Scorpios are extremely deep and emotional people, and are **intense in all things they do**. When a Scorpio wants something, **they go for it and they don't hold back**. Stubbornness can be a helpful trait, since it means Scorpios stand their ground, and stick to their principles. ## Scorpio Traits in Relationships. Knowing more about how Scorpios feel about relationships can help you connect to Scorpios, or learn how to be a better friend, partner, or employee if you are a Scorpio yourself. ## Tips for Relating to a Scorpio. **Scorpios respect people who stand up for themselves**, and who can tell it like it is without holding anything back.
